description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableQueue class in the Orleans.Journaling project. The tests verify queue operations such as enqueue, dequeue, peek, persistence, handling of complex types, clearing, empty case handling, enumeration, large volume operations, and concurrent usage using the xUnit testing framework.

classes.name: DurableQueueTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the DurableQueue implementation, ensuring correctness, durability, serialization, recovery, and concurrency handling.

methods.name: DurableQueue_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests basic FIFO queue operations: enqueue, peek, dequeue, and count, verifying order and persistence.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that the queue's state is properly persisted and can be recovered after reinitialization.

methods.name: DurableQueue_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Checks serialization/deserialization of custom complex objects enqueued in the queue.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Clear_Test
methods.description: Tests the clear operation to ensure it empties the queue and that the operation is journaled.

methods.name: DurableQueue_EmptyQueueOperations_Test
methods.description: Validates that peek and dequeue throw exceptions when the queue is empty.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Ensures the queue supports enumeration in FIFO order.

methods.name: DurableQueue_LargeNumberOfOperations_Test
methods.description: Stress test enqueuing a large number of items and recovering the entire queue state.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Concurrent_EnqueueDequeue_Test
methods.description: Simulates concurrent enqueue and dequeue operations, verifying correct order and recovery.
